findings.title: Manual-review redirect cause is identified only by error text
findings.evidence: examples/v3-room/src/index.ts permits the application onAcceptedVertex callback to throw, stores any such error in terminalFailure, and classifies any TypeError whose message equals the manual-review message as the target-hold cause. A non-hold callback throwing that same TypeError can therefore bypass the existing generic migration-activation failure mapping even though no durable target hold caused it.
findings.required_action: Parent f5b room-lifecycle owner: before parent closure, replace message-only provenance with a private non-exported brand or equivalent internal marker set only by the target-hold path, preserve the exact public TypeError message, and add a retained non-hold collision test. No public API is needed.

golden_path_fit: The signed RED is causal and the rejected runs remain explicitly excluded. GREEN establishes a durable prompt fail-closed hold, preserves creator-close and orderly-reopen behavior, freezes retained store identity/link/progress, and leaves parent codec/frontier, close-adopt, 64-writer, and long-horizon work correctly unclaimed.
